item.title: Daon Develops Five-Patent Architecture for Quantum-Ready Digital Identity
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – Daon®, The Digital Identity Trust Company, today introduced its Quantum Identity architecture, a patent-backed approach designed to help future identity systems determine not only whether cryptography remains secure, but whether the biometric and authentication evidence entering the system is genuine.
